commands.review_summary:
The PR adds exact local W&B sandbox claims, endpoint/entity/project scope checks, provider inventory ownership checks, rollback/claim cleanup handling, docs, and W&B smoke/test coverage for run/status/stop ownership.

Reproducibility: yes. Current main and v0.34.0 have a source-visible path where W&B `run --id`, `status --id`, and `stop --id` pass caller-supplied IDs to provider operations without exact local ownership proof; I did not run live provider mutation.

target.title: fix: enforce W&B sandbox ownership
target.body:
## Summary

- bind W&B existing-sandbox run, status, and stop paths to an exact local claim containing the provider sandbox ID and W&B endpoint/entity/project scope
- require the claimed sandbox to remain present in provider inventory with the `crabbox` tag; labels, names, or raw IDs alone never authorize use or deletion
- re-verify the unchanged claim immediately before command execution and serialize stop/claim deletion under the claim lock
- roll back a newly created remote sandbox when claim persistence fails
- add a cleanup-armed, isolated-state W&B live canary and document the ownership boundary; `--reclaim` remains unsupported because the pinned API cannot establish safe adoption

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/786

## Verification

Current candidate: `8b96b11748e69d56afb5863c91b5a05a6b6924e2`

Local validation on the current candidate:

- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- `go test -race ./internal/providers/wandb ./internal/cli -count=1`
- `go vet ./internal/providers/wandb ./internal/cli`
- `scripts/check-docs.sh`
- `node --test scripts/wandb-smoke.test.js scripts/live-smoke.test.js` (51 passed)
- full-branch autoreview clean with no accepted/actionable findings (0.86)

Hosted validation on the current candidate is running.

## Pre-merge live gate

Authenticated W&B access is not available in the maintainer environment: the exact W&B environment variables are unset, no `api.wandb.ai` netrc entry or W&B CLI is present, and targeted approved 1Password lookups found no matching credential item. Keep this PR unmerged until `scripts/wandb-smoke.sh` passes on this exact head, proving a tagged exact-claim sandbox can run/status/stop, a tagged but unclaimed sandbox is denied on the changed existing-ID paths, and cleanup leaves zero remote and local residue; alternatively record an explicit item-specific waiver.

## Security / configuration

No new credential or persisted-secret requirement. The live canary accepts `CRABBOX_WANDB_API_KEY` or `WANDB_API_KEY` only from the process environment and uses isolated Crabbox state.
